about_title: A digital standard of legality and quality in occupational safety in Kazakhstan
about_lead: Our goal is the technological modernisation of training and knowledge assessment for workers at industrial enterprises of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
about_mission_p1: Historically, occupational and industrial safety training in Kazakhstan faced formalism: issuing qualification certificates without a real knowledge check, paper tests vulnerable to cheating and forgery, and a heavy bureaucratic load on training-centre methodologists.
about_mission_p2: SmartSafety transforms this sector. We provide independent digital infrastructure that makes training transparent, protected from cheating, and legally sound during state labour-inspection audits.
about_pillar1_text: The platform is built on Article 79 of the Labour Code of Kazakhstan, Knowledge Assessment Rules No. 1019, and the Law on Civil Protection. Every passed exam creates a legitimate digital trail.
about_pillar2_text: Built-in copy blocking, search-engine lockout, tab-switch prevention, and server-side answer matching guarantee that the cadet sits the test in person.
about_pillar3_text: A training centre can train and certify thousands of workers from major industrial holdings in Kazakhstan without expanding teaching staff or handling paper by hand.
about_npa_title: Legal framework for deployment in Kazakhstan
about_npa1_title: Article 79 of the Labour Code of the Republic of Kazakhstan
about_npa1_text: It regulates working-time records and mandatory briefings and knowledge checks. SmartSafety electronic protocols with a digital ID are accepted by the labour inspectorate as proper evidence of completed training.
about_npa2_text: “On approval of the Rules and timeframes for training, briefing, and knowledge assessment on occupational safety.” The exam module is strictly set to an 80% pass threshold and a regulated time limit.
about_npa3_title: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan “On Civil Protection”
about_npa3_text: Certification of personnel at hazardous production facilities. It prevents untrained workers from being admitted to mining, drilling, and electrical installation work.
about_data_title: Data security and sovereignty in Kazakhstan
about_data_text: All platform servers are located in the Republic of Kazakhstan in accordance with the Law on Personal Data and Their Protection. Cadet personal data (full name, enterprises, test results) are transmitted over encrypted channels (SSL/TLS) and are not shared with third parties.
